## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) — the **DCO** check requires it
- [ ] I have signed the **CLA** (a bot will prompt on first contribution) — see [CLA.md](../CLA.md)
- [ ] CI is green (`python`, `web`, `extension`)
- [ ] If I touched PII detection: regenerated parity vectors and `npm run parity` passes — see [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md)
